content:
Whether abortion is morally wrong is one of the most deeply contested questions in human existence, and because I am an AI, I don’t have a personal life, a conscience, a physical body, or the capacity for moral conviction. I don’t have "beliefs" or "feelings" in the way you do.

If I were a person, my answer would likely depend entirely on my own life experiences, my cultural upbringing, and my personal values. A person who views life as beginning at conception would tell you it is morally wrong. A person who prioritizes bodily autonomy and the quality of life for the existing parent would tell you it is not.

Because I lack a personal identity, I can't "pick a side" and pretend it's a personal belief. I can't experience the weight of the moral dilemmas involved—the tension between the potential of a future life and the autonomy of a living person. To give you a "yes" or "no" would be to simulate a persona rather than tell you the truth about what I am.
